content.text:
build:
      context: /workspace
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    environment:
--
      SVA_INSTANCE_PROVISIONER_INTERNAL_BASE_URL: http://provisioner:3000
      SVA_MAINSERVER_SCOPE_RESOLVER_MODE: shadow
      SVA_PARENT_DOMAIN: ""
      SVA_PLUGIN_OPERATION_WORKER_ENABLED: "true"
--
    image: ghcr.io/smart-village-solutions/sva-studio
    networks:
      default: null
    ports:
--
  bootstrap:
    build:
      context: /workspace
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    entrypoint:
--
    image: ghcr.io/smart-village-solutions/sva-studio
    networks:
      default: null
  candidate:
--
    image: ghcr.io/smart-village-solutions/sva-studio:latest
    networks:
      default: null
    read_only: true
--
  migrate:
    build:
      context: /workspace
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    entrypoint:
--
    image: ghcr.io/smart-village-solutions/sva-studio
    networks:
      default: null

observation.command: cd /workspace && SVA_ENABLE_MONITORING=false docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.override.yaml config 2>&1 | grep -A3 -E 'provisioner:|migrate:|bootstrap:|image:|build:' | head -40
